physical_conditions.note: Carrier packets are the Week 3 clean set. Sensor values are the firmware rand() stub. Only humidity is modified.

parameters.sigma_source: synthetic baseline dispersion of the rand() stub, std 1.503. No physical referent exists for this channel.
parameters.design: Identical carrier design: every packet-track episode uses the same source packets, so the only difference between an attacked record and its clean twin (source_packet_id) is the target channel value.

integrity.verified: every record decrypts and passes HMAC under host_receiver logic
integrity.note: hmac_recomputed is true in the sense that the stored HMAC is valid for the modified payload, which is the IP-F attacker capability being modelled. labels_schema_v1.0.0 describes IP-D with hmac_recomputed=false for datasets where the HMAC is left stale; this dataset deliberately recomputes it.

known_limitations: Carrier sensor values are synthetic; a detector separating these records from clean ones is detecting a departure from a known pseudo-random stream, not physical implausibility.
Carrier is fragmented (longest run 9). Suitable for static per-packet attacks only.
humidity has no physical sensor and no twin; its sigma is the synthetic baseline dispersion.
